description: This file defines a 'Home' component for a weather application front-end, using the LightningJS framework. It imports components and defines the UI layout, along with lifecycle methods for initialization.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the main page of a weather app, including current weather, highlights, and tips panels.

methods.name: mounted
methods.description: Lifecycle method executed when the component is mounted to the DOM; shows a welcome toast and sets a default location.
